closeout_failures.failed_witness: The combined x2 commit, push, and equality command returned after the push without its promised equality summary.
closeout_failures.recovery: Resolved local, upstream, tracking, fresh-live, clean-state, and divergence evidence through separate read-only scalar probes.
closeout_failures.recurrence_guard: Separate a potentially long push from the post-push four-way equality projection.

closeout_failures.failed_witness: The first divergence recovery let PowerShell reinterpret an unquoted upstream token and emitted a fatal revision error; its displayed 0/0 received no credit.
closeout_failures.recovery: Resolved literal head and upstream hashes first, then passed their explicit revision range to the divergence command and proved typed 0/0.
closeout_failures.recurrence_guard: Resolve PowerShell-sensitive Git revision shorthands to literal hashes before composing a revision range.

closeout_failures.failed_witness: The first exact-name lookup for Orin final templates returned no matches because the guessed filtering expression did not match the source-tree paths.
closeout_failures.recovery: Used a bounded case-insensitive source-tree inventory, identified the exact three templates, and copied only those into Liora-owned paths.
closeout_failures.recurrence_guard: Inventory the exact immutable source tree before selecting owner-specific template filenames.

operational_failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first bulk template-seeding projection exceeded its output window, so its result was not attributable.
operational_failed_witnesses.recovery: Audited the three exact target paths, lengths, adaptation markers, and Git status; all intended untracked files had persisted, so no copy was replayed.
operational_failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: After a projection overflow, inspect exact persisted targets before deciding whether any write must be repeated.

operational_failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first contract replacement patch combined delete and add operations for the same path and was rejected by the patch tool.
operational_failed_witnesses.recovery: Applied a targeted in-place semantic patch to the unchanged untracked contract file.
operational_failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Use one in-place Update File operation when replacing content at a single existing path.

operational_failed_witnesses.failed_witness: A first flashcard inspection guessed a nonexistent x1 flashcard-index.json path.
operational_failed_witnesses.recovery: A bounded x1 file inventory identified flashcard-freeze.json, whose exact schema and 67 cards were then projected.
operational_failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Inventory exact filenames before selecting a phase artifact by semantic role.

operational_failed_witnesses.failed_witness: A stale-label adjudication passed a literal Windows wildcard path to ripgrep and returned an invalid-filename error.
operational_failed_witnesses.recovery: Scanned the scripts directory with an explicit runner include glob; zero runner stale-label candidates were found.
operational_failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: On Windows, express ripgrep file selection with -g against a directory instead of a wildcard path argument.

operational_recovery_witnesses.recovery: Audited the three exact target paths, lengths, adaptation markers, and Git status; all intended untracked files had persisted, so no copy was replayed.
